trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 105 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a high frequency of irregular, jagged peaks and valleys, particularly concentrated on the distal half of both lobes, transitioning to a smoother profile near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep on both lobes, ending in highly irregular, fringed terminal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jagged fringing and multiple small protrusions/irregularities along the terminal edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.
